contribution.stance_summary: Do not fade US 2Y just because it prints a 252-day high: it sits on the live SR3 path after a delivered, pre-priced hike with still-hot US gauges. The stretched object with a reversal condition is Australia: AU 2Y 4.999 as of 2026-09-16 sits through live AONIA (overnight 4.35; Oct-26 4.565; Mar-27 4.86; path peak 4.945) after 16 Sep housing evidence that the tightening channel is already biting. Fade the remaining 21-51bp of priced RBA hikes in the AONIA strip, not AUDUSD.

catalysts: Next Australian housing, prices, stamp-duty and labor prints confirming the 16 Sep contraction.
RBA communication that treats the housing channel as binding and declines to deliver the remaining Oct-Mar AONIA hikes.
AU 2Y giving back the residual through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86 as the path, not the inflation narrative, reasserts.

context_build.causal_mechanism: RBA cash is already restrictive at AONIA 4.35. Incremental tightening is transmitted through housing turnover, prices and state tax receipts with a lag. Once that channel is contracting, inflation-gauge heat that is already in the price cannot by itself justify another 21-51bp of hikes. The testable claim is that the live AONIA strip still prices that extra tightening as if the housing channel were not yet binding.
context_build.flow_and_positioning_check: CFTC trader-class nets and CME positioning overlays are unavailable this freeze (known gap). The AU 2Y / AONIA move cannot be attributed to documented crowding, CTA, or dealer plumbing. Absence of positioning is not permission to infer a squeeze; it lowers confidence and leaves the housing and policy-path evidence as the independent case.

AU 2Y observation is three days stale versus the 2026-09-19T21:40:00Z cutoff; AONIA is the live tradable path. Temperature gauges are dashboard_v8 retained. Mixed analog 3m outcomes mean the housing prints, not the 99th percentile, must do the work.

New as of 16 Sep: NSW stamp-duty receipts -24 percent year over year, transaction volumes -18 percent, Sydney and Melbourne values more than 7 percent below peak. That is a new transmission of already-known tightening. Unknown: live CFTC/CME positioning (unavailable this freeze); whether subsequent CPI/trimmed-mean re-accelerates from the packet's inflation-gauge 82 without new housing confirmation.

context_build.market_implied_assumption: AONIA prices the RBA to deliver about +21.5bp by Oct-26, +33.5bp by Nov-26 and +51bp by Mar-27, with a 2027 terminal near 4.945, despite the housing contraction. INFERENCE: crowded extrapolation of inflation-gauge 82 plus the delivered Fed hike has overshot the RBA's remaining hike capacity now that the housing channel is binding; the extra 21-51bp should be faded. UNKNOWN: positioning and the next CPI vintage. This is not a US 2Y fade and not an AONIA-easing call.
why_now: 16 Sep housing research is dated new transmission of known RBA tightening; the Fed hike that day was already >90 percent priced and is now delivered, so it is not a fresh AU-hike catalyst.
AU 2Y as of 2026-09-16 prints through live Mar-27 AONIA 4.86 and through the AONIA peak 4.945; that sovereign-versus-path residual is open at the 2026-09-19T21:40:00Z freeze.

Funded seats pay official SOFR 3.85 ACT/360 on the full $100m even if flat; fading 21-51bp of extra AONIA hike premium with a defined housing invalidation is the seat's attempt to clear that hurdle rather than sit in cash.

events.rationale: Do not fade US 2Y just because it prints a 252-day high: it sits on the live SR3 path after a delivered, pre-priced hike with still-hot US gauges. The stretched object with a reversal condition is Australia: AU 2Y 4.999 as of 2026-09-16 sits through live AONIA (overnight 4.35; Oct-26 4.565; Mar-27 4.86; path peak 4.945) after 16 Sep housing evidence that the tightening channel is already biting. Fade the remaining 21-51bp of priced RBA hikes in the AONIA strip, not AUDUSD.

holes_in_opposing_case: catalyst-junkie is the only same-contract opponent, and the opposite-direction flag is a paper-sign error, not an opposite thesis. Packet futures are marked in implied-rate space. Long AONIA_2026-10 is long implied 4.565 (pay the remaining +21.5bp). Their own prose wants that contract to reprice lower after housing (stamp-duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, values >7% off peak) and labels the trade long/receive. Those cannot both be true on this mark. If the book follows their direction field, they are paying the last near-full October hike after the transmission channel has already broken. If they meant receive, they are same-side as short implied AONIA and there is no economic fade to answer.

Even granting their meeting-catalyst frame, it does not create a reason to pay October. Inflation gauge 82 is already in AONIA 4.35 and in AU 2Y 4.999; it does not independently validate +21.5bp more by Oct-26 once activity/labor/consumer are 54/50/48. A dated RBA window is a timing device for the same housing residual I already own in AONIA_2026-10. It is not a new discrepancy, and their carry_view opposes_trade is the cost of sitting in the vig, not evidence the hike must print.

rate-hawk and trend-follower smuggle AU rates higher off a US continuation that I already refused to fade. US 2Y 4.76 matches SR3U7 4.755 after a >90% pre-priced hike into gauges 72/75/69/74; that is path-consistent, not through-the-path. AU 2Y 4.999 is 13.9bp through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86. Trend-follower even writes AU housing as the anti-analog and says this seat does not pay AONIA, which guts their own au_rates_view:higher tag. Paying SOFR_2027-09 does not require paying AONIA_2026-10.

perma-bull’s USD-lower NZDUSD call does not own the AONIA residual. They concede AUD is not cheap and that the Australian housing channel is biting, which is my AUD-lower / AU-rates-lower mechanism. NZ rates are unavailable, so they cannot show NZD is cheap versus a policy path. Q2 GDP 0.2% q/q that slows and beats is not a USD-down regime and does not put the remaining 21-51bp of RBA hikes back on the table.

carry-is-king’s short CA-US_2Y (pay CA 3.27 / receive US 4.76) treats a 5y 4th-percentile spread as a hold while the spread sits next to overnight CORRA 2.29 minus SOFR 3.85 = -156bp. That is the policy differential, not an independent cheapness. Paying Canada also fights labor 38 and core near 2%. I rejected that RV in round 1 for this reason; it is not a reason to pay AONIA either.

dollar-king long USDCAD is a different pair and the same USD-higher side as my AUD residual. Percentile 74 on USDCAD is their own admission the pair is not stretched. It supplies no housing-versus-AONIA evidence.

perma-bear and rate-dove receive 2027 CORRA, which agrees with my AU-rates-down direction and does not reverse AONIA_2026-10. Their Canada 100bp-plus hike-path objection is the trade I already declined: CA 2Y 5y percentile 58.6 and CA-US 2Y are overnight-anchored. That is not an AONIA pay case.

attack: Strongest opposing claim on the direct conflict: that AONIA_2026-10 should be long. On the frozen implied-rate mark that is a pay-rates trade. Paying +21.5bp of October tightening after NSW stamp-duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, and Sydney/Melbourne >7% off peak is the crowded inflation-82 extrapolation. Independent checks still fail it: AU activity/labor/consumer 54/50/48, AU 2Y already through Mar-27 AONIA 4.86, AUDUSD 1y percentile 76.4 not stretched.

Strongest genuine macro pushback is rate-hawk/trend-follower global-tightening continuation. It attacks the wrong market. I do not fade path-consistent US 2Y. I fade remaining RBA hike premium where the housing channel is already binding. Their own AU housing notes support that split.

perma-bull USD_DOWN is an NZD residual with no NZ policy path. It cannot falsify short implied AONIA. USD_UP on my synopsis is the AUD-pair implication of AU rates down, not a USDCAD or NZDUSD mandate.
defense: Original stands: short AONIA_2026-10 in implied-rate space equals receive / AU rates down. Lead contract implied 4.565, +21.5bp vs overnight 4.35, OI 21752, volume 4450. Same locked strip 2026-10/2026-11/2027-03. Family stays AONIA; do not migrate onto AU_2Y.

Thesis is housing transmission versus remaining hike premium, not a 99th-percentile AU 2Y rank and not a US 2Y fade. Known inflation 82 explains restrictive AONIA 4.35; it does not justify the extra Oct-Mar 21-51bp after the 16 Sep housing print.

Uncertainty preserved: inflation 82 can still force a delivered October hike; Fed/SR3 spillover can delay the fade; AU 2Y as_of 2026-09-16 is stale versus the cutoff; CFTC/CME positioning is missing; AU 2Y analog list is empty. Those are already principal risks, not reasons to flip sign.

What would concede: RBA delivers the priced October 25bp, or AONIA holds/lifts packet Oct-26 4.565 and Mar-27 4.86 while housing/labor stop confirming the channel is biting, or Mar-27 AONIA rises through packet AU 2Y 4.999. A catalyst-junkie direction-field long that still wants implied rates down is not a concession.
